name: plan-usage
description: Shows your Claude plan's session and weekly limits above the prompt, gives Claude a plan_usage tool to check them at no token cost, and can pause a long-running session before the session limit and continue after it resets.

warn_at.title: Warning level (percent)
warn_at.description: From this percent of a limit, the band turns orange and reads HIGH.

time_zone.title: Time zone
time_zone.description: IANA time zone for reset times, such as America/Chicago. Leave empty to use this computer's.

auto_pause.title: Pause near the session limit
auto_pause.description: When the session limit reaches the threshold, let running tool calls finish, stop the turn, and continue 2 minutes after the limit resets.

pause_threshold.title: Pause threshold (percent)
pause_threshold.description: Session-limit percent that starts the pause when it is on.

resume_prompt.title: Resume prompt
resume_prompt.description: What the session is sent when it continues after a pause.
resume_prompt.default: Plan usage reset; resume where you left off from the files on disk.
